title: Aparat pentru alungarea pasarilor Sonic Bird Chaser ref 3473
description:
Dispozitivul Sonic BirdChaser foloseste principiul redarii trilurilor de vanatoare ale pasarilor pradatoare ( vultur, bufnita, soim ) pentru a tine la distanta specii precum porumbei, randunele, graurii, ciorile, vrabiile si alte specii de pasari. Aparatul poate fi utilizat in 2 moduri printr-un comutator: 1. AUTO - Aparatul Birdchaser va emite trilurile de primejdie ale pasarilor pradatoare la fiecare interval de timp cuprins intre 5 - 30 de minute automat pe durata zilei. Se poate ajusta intervalul si volumul la nivelul dorit. In acest caz suprafata maxim protejata este de 400 m². Fotocelula incorporata va dezactiva acest mod de functionare in intuneric, atunci cand activitatea majoritatii pasarilor este aproape nula. In modul de functionare AUTO, LED-ul indicator clipeste. 2. PIR MODE - Cand detectorul electronic detecteaza intrarea pasarilor in raza sa de actiune, aparatul emite triluri de primejdie (maxim 120 decibeli) care este inregistrat pe un microcip din unitate. Detectorul foloseste cel mai nou tip de radar iar sunetele emise nu sunt "deranjante" pentru om. Aparatul va proteja o suprafata, cu un unghi de emitere de 130 grade si o distanta de detectie de aprox. 10 metri. In modul de functionare PIR MODE, LED-ul ce indica functionarea aparatului lumineaza continuu. Aparatul functioneaza pe timpul zilei, la intuneric si pe timpul noptii se opreste. description: Das Institut für Raumfahrtsysteme (IRS) an der Universität Stuttgart benötigt GNSS Empfänger für den 80 kg SmallSat ROMEO. GNSS-Empfänger sind ein wichtiger Bestandteil des Lage- und Orbitkontrollsystems für Satelliten. Sie können die genaue Position und Geschwindigkeit des Satelliten im Weltraum messen sowie die genaue Zeit angeben. Dies ist für präzise Lageregelungsmanöver und Orbitmanöver erforderlich. of cis-lunar space and act as a ‘basecamp’ for sustained 
lunar exploration. The Lunar Gateway is smaller than 
the ISS and will require less launches for its assembly.

in the negotiation phase with selected bidder

title: ERS-EO ALPSTAR PHASE A/B1 STUDY FOR A BESPOKE SAR MISSION WITH OPTIONAL ELINT (ACTIVITY 3)
description: The ALPSTAR Phase A/B1 study for a bespoke X band SAR mission, with optional ELINT capability, aims to define a technically feasible, sovereign European space segment architecture aligned with emerging user needs and the ALPSTAR federated concept. Conducted through up to two parallel industrial contracts within participating states, the study focuses on the design of a high performance SAR payload as the primary driver, including its integration on a mature platform (TRL 8-9), while assessing the feasibility, added value,and implementation impacts of incorporating an ELINT capability either as an embedded or hosted payload. The activity includes mission and system architecture definition, interface specification with the ground and federation layers, compliance with SRD and evolving MRD use cases, and evaluation of key technologies and TRL gaps. It further delivers preliminary design solutions, end to end performance considerations (including L0/L1 processing and ELINT simulation), trade offs, and a credible roadmap toward flight readiness. Outputs also encompass a comprehensive development and procurement plan, industrial organisation, launcher options, and robust ROMcost and schedule estimates for subsequent B2/C/D/E phases, ensuring decision readiness for the ALPSTAR Governance Board.
